newsitem.title: USA: Delware Gov to nominate Carney for finance post.
newsitem.headline: Delware Gov to nominate Carney for finance post.

text.p: Delaware Gov Thomas Carper said Monday he will nominate John Carney Jr for confirmation as the state's next Secretary of Finance.
Carney, 40, has served as Gov Carper's deputy chief of staff since 1994, where he also works on the budget and finance team.
Prior to his work for Gov Carper, Carney served as acting director of public works for New Castle County and from 1989 to 1994 as the county's Deputy Chief Administrative Officer.

Carper said in a statement he will send Carney's name to the state Senate later this week, "with the hope of having him confirmed" before the General Assembly adjourns at the end of month for the Joint Committee break.
If confirmed, Carney will replace Sarah Jackson, who resigned the post she held since 1993 to pursue other opportunities.
